name: 許晉源
objective:
風險評估、風險管理及風險政策等工具已成為現代社會管理人類活動和產品造成的環境及健康問題。本課程的目的為培育跨領域了解環境風險及利用自然科學及社會科學的觀點和方法進行管理。同時包含探討環境風險評估管理所用的方法、相關理論和假設，並了解其作用。
Risk, assessment, risk management and risk governance have become key concepts in modern society's attempts to manage environmental and health problems connected with human activities and products. The object of this course is to train an integrated interdisciplinary understanding of environmental risks and their management by perspectives and approaches from natural and social sciences. This course also critically examines the role of risk assessment in environmental management by checking the methods used, as well as the underlying theories and assumptions.
課程進度(1-16週):
1st Week:
環境風險的定義與分類 / Definition and classification of environmental risk
2nd Week:
環境風險的成因與影響 / Causes and impacts
3rd Week:
環境風險與永續發展的關係 / Relationship between environmental risk and sustainable development
4th ~ 5th Week:
風險識別與分析 / Risk identification and analysis
5th ~ 6th Week:
危害識別與評估 / Hazard identification and assessment
7th ~ 9th Week:
暴露評估 / Exposure assessment
10th ~ 12th Week:
風險特徵評估 / Risk characterization
13th ~ 14th Week:
國際標準在風險管理的應用 / Application of International Standards in Risk Management
15th Week:
環境風險管理策略 / Environmental Risk Management Strategies
16th Week:
具體環境風險案例研究 / Case Studies of Specific Environmental Risks
17th ~ 18th Week:
期末報告 / Final Presentation
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          本課程於第 17 至 18 週採取彈性學習模式，由學生進行分組專題報告與討論。學生需針對特定的環境風險或健康風險案例進行深入探討，內容涵蓋危害識別、暴露評估、風險特徵評估及提出相應的管理策略，並於課堂上進行分組簡報與同儕跨領域交流討論。
In Weeks 17-18, a flexible learning mode is adopted through student group presentations and discussions. Student groups will select specific environmental or health risk case studies, analyzing hazard identification, exposure assessment, and risk characterization, and proposing management strategies followed by in-class oral presentations and peer discussions.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          繳交分組期末專題報告（含簡報 PPT 及書面報告）。

評量方式包含：教師評分（報告深度、風險評估邏輯與解決方案可行性）、同儕互評及現場問答表現。

1. Submission of group final project (including presentation slides and a written report).
2. Evaluation methods: Instructor grading (depth of analysis, logic of risk assessment, and feasibility of solutions), peer review, and performance in Q & A session.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          彈性學習週之分組報告與成果評量占本課程總成績 50%（即對應評量方式中之「期末報告」）。

The learning outcomes of the flexible learning weeks (group presentation) account for 50% of the final grade (corresponding to the "Final Report" in the evaluation policy).
